name: Pranamasana
breathing_cue: Exhale — Bring palms together in front of the chest.
description: The opening and closing prayer stance of the Sun Salutation sequence.
benefits: Calms the nervous system, centers the mind, and establishes steady breathing rhythm.
instructions:
1. Stand upright with feet together.
2. Bring palms together in Anjali Mudra at heart center.
3. Relax shoulders downward and lengthen spine.
precautions: Keep weight evenly distributed across both feet; avoid locking knees.

rules.feedback_message: Stand straight with your spine erect
Keep left leg straight without locking the knee
Keep right leg straight without locking the knee
Hold palms firmly in front of the heart

name: Hasta Uttanasana
breathing_cue: Inhale — Sweep arms up and gently arch the upper back.
description: Upward expansion and arch of the thoracic spine with raised arms.
benefits: Expands chest capacity, stretches abdomen, and stimulates thyroid gland.
instructions:
1. Inhale deeply and sweep arms overhead.
2. Keep biceps close to ears.
3. Gently arch upper back while maintaining core engagement.
precautions: Avoid over-compressing the lumbar spine; lift from the chest.

rules.feedback_message: Extend your left arm straight overhead
Extend your right arm straight overhead
Gently lift your chest upward and backward
Keep both legs stable and straight

name: Uttanasana
breathing_cue: Exhale — Fold forward from the hips, bringing hands toward the floor.
description: Deep standing forward fold stretching the entire posterior chain.
benefits: Deeply stretches hamstrings and calves, calms the brain, and aids digestion.
instructions:
1. Exhale and hinge from the hip joints.
2. Keep spine long as you fold forward.
3. Bring hands beside feet on the floor.
precautions: Bend knees slightly if hamstrings or lower back feel strained.

rules.feedback_message: Hinge deeper from the hips toward your thighs
Fold evenly through both hips
Keep legs extended without hyperextending knees

name: Ashwa Sanchalanasana (Right Leg Back)
breathing_cue: Inhale — Step right leg far back, drop right knee, gaze forward.
description: Low lunge position stretching the hip flexors and strengthening the front thigh.
benefits: Strengthens quadriceps, increases hip flexibility, and tones abdominal organs.
instructions:
1. Step right leg far back and lower right knee to mat.
2. Bend left knee to 90 degrees over left ankle.
3. Press hips forward and gaze gently upward.
precautions: Ensure front left knee does not drift past left toes.

rules.feedback_message: Bend front left knee to a 90 degree angle
Keep torso open and upright
Extend right leg smoothly back

name: Dandasana (Plank Pose)
breathing_cue: Retain Breath — Step left leg back to join right leg in high plank.
description: Rigid, straight-body plank position forming the foundational core posture.
benefits: Builds intense core strength, stabilizes shoulders, and strengthens wrists.
instructions:
1. Step left leg back beside right leg.
2. Keep shoulders directly over wrists.
3. Form a straight line from crown of head to heels.
precautions: Do not let hips sag or poke excessively upward.

rules.feedback_message: Keep arms straight and firm below shoulders
Keep hips aligned in a straight line with spine
Engage thighs and keep legs fully straight

name: Ashtanga Namaskara
breathing_cue: Exhale — Lower knees, chest, and chin to floor with hips lifted.
description: Eight body parts touch the ground: feet, knees, hands, chest, and chin.
benefits: Strengthens arm and back muscles, enhances spinal flexibility.
instructions:
1. Lower both knees to floor.
2. Lower chest between hands and chin to mat.
3. Keep hips and abdomen slightly elevated.
precautions: Keep elbows tucked close to ribcage.

rules.feedback_message: Bend elbows back alongside your ribcage
Place knees on the mat with hips elevated
Keep chest close to the floor

name: Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose)
breathing_cue: Inhale — Slide chest forward and lift upward into Cobra.
description: Gentle backward spinal extension lifting the chest while pelvis rests on mat.
benefits: Strengthens entire spine, opens lungs and chest, relieves stress.
instructions:
1. Slide forward, uncurling toes.
2. Press hands into mat and lift chest upward.
3. Roll shoulders down and back away from ears.
precautions: Do not force height with arm strength; use spinal extensors.

rules.feedback_message: Lift chest up and open your heart forward
Keep slight softness in elbows; shoulders down
Keep legs extended together along the floor

name: Parvatasana / Downward Dog
breathing_cue: Exhale — Tuck toes and lift hips upward into inverted V.
description: Inverted V-posture with hips driving toward the ceiling.
benefits: Energizes body, strengthens arms and legs, stretches hamstrings.
instructions:
1. Tuck toes under and lift hips high toward sky.
2. Press heels toward mat and lengthen through spine.
3. Form an inverted V shape with body.
precautions: Press evenly into palms to protect wrists.

rules.feedback_message: Lift hips high toward the ceiling to form inverted V
Press firmly through straight arms
Straighten legs and sink heels toward the mat

name: Ashwa Sanchalanasana (Right Leg Forward)
breathing_cue: Inhale — Step right foot forward between hands, drop left knee.
description: Low lunge with right foot forward and left leg extended back.
benefits: Increases hip flexibility, tones thigh muscles, and aids balance.
instructions:
1. Step right foot forward between palms.
2. Drop left knee to floor and press hips forward.
3. Lift chest and look gently forward.
precautions: Keep front right knee vertically stacked over right ankle.

rules.feedback_message: Bend front right knee to 90 degrees
Keep chest elevated and spine tall
Extend back left leg smoothly

name: Uttanasana (Forward Fold)
breathing_cue: Exhale — Step left foot forward beside right, folding down.
description: Deep standing forward bend bringing forehead toward shins.
benefits: Relieves tension in spine and hamstrings, calms mind.
instructions:
1. Step left foot forward to meet right foot.
2. Fold forward from hips.
3. Bring hands beside feet or hold ankles.
precautions: Avoid rounding the upper back aggressively.

rules.feedback_message: Hinge deeply at the hips
Keep legs straight with subtle knee softness
Fold upper body smoothly toward legs

name: Hasta Uttanasana
breathing_cue: Inhale — Sweep arms overhead, arch spine slightly backward.
description: Upward standing stretch opening chest and abdominal muscles.
benefits: Expands lung capacity and tones back and shoulder muscles.
instructions:
1. Inhale and rise all the way up.
2. Sweep arms overhead and back.
3. Look upward toward thumbs.
precautions: Keep glutes slightly engaged to protect lower back.

rules.feedback_message: Reach arms straight overhead
Reach arms straight overhead
Lift chest up and arch gently back

name: Pranamasana / Relax
breathing_cue: Exhale — Lower hands to heart center and breathe steadily.
description: Final completion of the cycle, standing balanced in peaceful stillness.
benefits: Restores baseline heart rate, integrates the benefits of the cycle.
instructions:
1. Bring palms back together at heart center.
2. Lower arms to sides into Tadasana when ready.
3. Take 3 deep, grounding breaths.
precautions: Observe body sensations without sudden movements.

rules.feedback_message: Stand tall, relaxed and centered
Keep legs steady and grounded
Keep legs steady and grounded
